issue.title: Improvement request raised by Aiden (P0, scheduled as a key iteration right after the China National Day holiday, i.e.
issue.summary: Improvement request raised by Aiden (P0, scheduled as a key iteration right after the China National Day holiday, i.e. from 2026-10-08). Today, when a user is @-mentioned in a muted (DND) group, the only cue is a small green '[@ mentioned]' text in the conversation-list preview. There is no new-message indicator, no unread badge on the conversation, and no count on the top-right / tab / app-icon badge, so users routinely miss messages addressed to them. Original feedback from Ellery Wang: 'When I am @-mentioned in a muted group there is only a green text hint, no new-message indicator or top-right badge, so I often miss group messages. Can we match WeChat, where any @ always produces a new-message indicator + badge?' Scope: (1) an @-mention addressed to me must always produce a new-message indicator + unread badge regardless of the group's mute state (WeChat parity); (2) add a Slack-style 'Mentions / @Me' aggregated list that collects every message that @-mentions me across all conversations in one place.
steps: Mute (DND) a group chat on any client (Web / macOS / Windows / iOS / Android).
Have another member @-mention me in that muted group.
Observe the conversation list, the conversation's unread badge, the Chats tab / top-right badge and the app-icon badge.
Try to find all messages that @-mentioned me across groups — there is no single entry point for this.
issue.expected: (1) Any @-mention addressed to me (direct @me; @All/@Everyone per product rule) always shows a new-message indicator and increments the conversation's unread badge and the global (tab / top-right / app-icon) badge, even when the group is muted — matching WeChat. Muted groups' ordinary (non-@) messages keep the current silent behaviour. (2) A 'Mentions / @Me' list (Slack-style) aggregates every message that @-mentions me, newest first, with sender, group, time, message preview and read/unread state; tapping an item jumps to that message in context.
issue.actual: In a muted group an @-mention only renders a green '[@ mentioned]' text hint in the conversation preview. No new-message indicator, no conversation unread badge, no top-right / tab / app-icon badge count. There is no aggregated view of messages that mention me, so users miss them.
issue.featureArea: Messaging / Notification & Mention routing / Unread badge / Mentions inbox
issue.context:
- **Feature area**: Messaging / Notification & Mention routing / Unread badge / Mentions inbox
- Priority: P0 (set by Aiden). Schedule: key iteration right after the National Day holiday (from 2026-10-08). No milestone assigned — please attach one at sprint planning.
- Proposer: Aiden (Teamily userID 6296335850356299). Original feedback: Ellery Wang (Teamily userID 6226891335107934). Source: Teamily Product Team group chat (group 3106444614), 2026-09-29.
- Acceptance criteria AC1 — Muted group + direct @me: conversation shows a new-message indicator and unread badge; global badge (Chats tab / top-right / app icon) increments by the number of unread @me messages; verified on Web, macOS, Windows, iOS, Android.
- AC2 — Muted group + ordinary (non-@) message: behaviour unchanged (no badge contribution, no push), so #263 (muted messages must not inflate the badge) does not regress.
- AC3 — Muted group + @me: a system / push notification is delivered (mentions break through mute), consistent across Web and App; product to decide and document whether @All/@Everyone also breaks through mute.
- AC4 — Opening the conversation or reading the mentioned message clears the @ badge on every client (multi-device read sync); counts never get stuck.
- AC5 — A 'Mentions / @Me' entry exists on every client (e.g. sidebar / Activity tab on desktop & web, top-level entry on mobile) listing all messages that @-mention me across conversations, newest first, showing sender, conversation, time, preview and unread state, with its own unread count.
- AC6 — Tapping a Mentions item jumps to and highlights the exact message in its conversation (including history that needs loading); read state syncs back to the list.
- AC7 — The list supports mark-as-read / mark-all-read and pagination, and includes mentions from muted groups, @All/@Everyone (clearly distinguished) and, if in scope, CloudDoc mentions (see #1363).
- Duplicate check: indexed all 2,117 issues (titles + bodies) in Teamily-Inc/teamily-ai-all on 2026-09-29 for mention / @me / Mentions list / mute / 免打扰 / 角标 / badge / unread. No existing 'Mentions / @Me' list request. Related but NOT duplicates: #1821 (muted group suppresses @ notifications; closed as completed with comment '设计如此' / by design — this request deliberately changes that design), #263 (iOS muted-group messages inflating the badge; closed — the opposite direction, must not regress, see AC2), #1363 (CloudDoc mention notifications should go to the notification list; open — candidate content for the Mentions list), #1180 (multi-device sync lag / missed @; closed, different root cause).
- Reference patterns: WeChat (@ in a muted group still shows '[有人@我]' + badge), Slack (Activity → Mentions & reactions).

---
issue.environment: - **Platform / OS / Browser**: All clients — Web, macOS, Windows, iOS, Android (plus push notification channel)

quotes.text: Today, when a user is @-mentioned in a muted (DND) group, the only cue is a small green '[@ mentioned]' text in the conversation-list preview.
There is no new-message indicator, no unread badge on the conversation, and no count on the top-right / tab / app-icon badge, so users routinely miss messages addressed to them.
1. Mute (DND) a group chat on any client (Web / macOS / Windows / iOS / Android).
2. Have another member @-mention me in that muted group.

(1) Any @-mention addressed to me (direct @me; @All/@Everyone per product rule) always shows a new-message indicator and increments the conversation's unread badge and the global (tab / top-right / app-icon) badge, even when the group is muted — matching WeChat. Muted groups' ordinary (non-@) messages keep the current silent behaviour.

(2) A 'Mentions / @Me' list (Slack-style) aggregates every message that @-mentions me, newest first, with sender, group, time, message preview and read/unread state; tapping an item jumps to that message in context.

In a muted group an @-mention only renders a green '[@ mentioned]' text hint in the conversation preview. No new-message indicator, no conversation unread badge, no top-right / tab / app-icon badge count. There is no aggregated view of messages that mention me, so users miss them.
AC2 — Muted group + ordinary (non-@) message: behaviour unchanged (no badge contribution, no push), so #263 (muted messages must not inflate the badge) does not regress.
**Platform / OS / Browser**: All clients — Web, macOS, Windows, iOS, Android (plus push notification channel)

AC5 — A 'Mentions / @Me' entry exists on every client (e.g. sidebar / Activity tab on desktop & web, top-level entry on mobile) listing all messages that @-mention me across conversations, newest first, showing sender, conversation, time, preview and unread state, with its own unread count.

understanding.subject: 免打扰（mute / DND）群会话中别人发给我的一条「@我」消息，以及该群会话在会话列表里的未读角标、会话预览、Tab / 右上角 / App 图标全局角标；附带「@我的 / Mentions」聚合入口
understanding.trigger: 把某个群设为免打扰后，由群内另一位成员在该群里发一条 @ 到我（@me）的消息（q3、q4）
understanding.phenomenon: 被 @ 后会话预览只多出一条绿色「[有人@我]」文字提示；没有新消息提示、没有该会话的未读角标，Tab / 右上角 / App 图标也没有角标计数；同时没有任何「@我的」聚合入口，导致经常漏看 @ 自己的消息（q1、q2、q7）
understanding.expected: 任何 @ 到我（直接 @me，@所有人 按产品规则）都必然产生新消息提示，并使该会话未读角标与全局角标（Tab / 右上角 / App 图标）按未读 @我 条数累加，即使群处于免打扰；免打扰群的普通（非 @）消息保持静默、不计角标；另外提供按时间倒序聚合所有 @我 消息的「@我的 / Mentions」列表，点击可跳转到原消息（q5、q6、q11）
understanding.control: 免打扰群内的普通（非 @）消息：行为不变，不计入角标、不推送（AC2 / q8）

missing.need: 把某个群会话置为免打扰（DND / mute）的能力，以及能断言「该会话当前处于免打扰」的观察。固定元素里没有任何 mute 开关 / 会话设置项，动作原语里也没有 mute 动作，targets[].must 也无法表达「已免打扰」，因此 q3 的前置条件无法构造，也无法在预热里核对它成立。

由另一个测试账号（aaron+test2）在群里发出**真正 @ 到我**的消息的 Node。现有积木不可替代：teamily.typeMention 只键入「@」打开选择器、不选人、不发送；teamily.freezeMention 是 prepare-only 且输入完会关闭选择器并清空；teamily.sendMessage 只支持 plain / markdown-link 纯文本，发出去的字面「@aaron+test2」不会形成真实的 mention 实体。缺这个 Node，就无法构造 q4 的触发，也就无法让被测端产生「被 @」这一事件。

会话未读角标 / 会话列表「新消息提示」/ Tab 角标 / App 图标角标的确定性观察。REGIONS 只有 home/nav、chat/composer、rewrite-confirm/dialog、mention-picker/picker，没有会话列表行或底部 Tab 的参考区域；element / text 观察读不到数字角标，App 图标角标在 android-app 上完全不可读。q2、q5、q7 的核心断言（角标是否出现、计数是否累加、@ 与普通消息是否区分）没有 ① 通道可判，用 ai 去「看有没有角标」沒有区分度（同一条灰色行样式差异极小，且菜单/预览样式本身会干扰）。

移动端「@我的 / Mentions」一级入口的固定元素 id（以及打开后列表页的锚点元素 / 参考区域），用于 AC5 的存在性检查与 AC6 的跳转高亮检查。vocab.ELEMENTS 里 android-app 只有 nav.chat / nav.me / chatlist.search / chat.composer / chat.send / chat.rewrite / chat.rewriteCancel / chat.back，没有该入口；也没有可挂载它的页面（openPage 只支持 profile / artifacts / chat）。

selfCheck.R1: ok：本版不提交任何计划，未写出任何不在积木目录里的 id、Node、元素、观察或坐标；missing 里只描述「缺什么」，不假装它们存在。
selfCheck.R2: 阻塞：Issue 的对象是「别人在免打扰群里 @ 我」的一条消息，而构造该对象的唯一途径（另一账号发出真实 @mention）没有积木支持（见 missing[1]），也不存在可选的近似目标；按 R2/R8 不选近似对象凑数。
selfCheck.R3: 阻塞：触发动作是「另一位成员 @ 我」（q4）本身，不是它的下游操作；现有 Node 只能以纯文本发送或只打开 @ 选择器，无法完成该触发，故不写计划。
selfCheck.R4: n/a：未提交计划，因此不存在需要挂 expect(phenomenon) 的动作；若强行把检查放到轮末（会话列表、Tab 角标）就会违反 R4，所以不做。
selfCheck.R5: 阻塞：唯一能拿到的信号是会话预览里的绿色「[有人@我]」文字，而它正是触发界面自带的内容（违反 R5③），不能用来判命中；角标计数只能用 ai 目测，正常/异常两种状态下无法保证「有毛病一定失败、正常一定通过」（违反 R5①），故不写成检查。
selfCheck.R6: n/a：未提交计划；需要指出的是，即使提交，@ 产生的未读角标是留存状态，清除它需要打开会话并读消息（AC4），当前也没有可复位并核实的观察。
selfCheck.R7: 阻塞：对照子用例（免打扰群 + 普通非 @ 消息，AC2 / q8）与主用例共用同一个不可构造的 mute 前置（missing[0]），并且同样需要「另一账号在群里发消息后保持未读」，无法构造对照组。
selfCheck.R8: ok：feasibility.status = needs-block，missing 逐条写了缺什么、为什么需要、引用片段编号，共 4 项（mute 前置、@mention 发送 Node、角标观察、@我的 入口元素）。
selfCheck.R9: n/a（本次不换端执行，仍为 android-app）。需留意：Issue 要求 Web / macOS / Windows / iOS / Android 全端验证并与 App 图标角标一致（q10），单 android-app 端本身就覆盖不了其中大部分；若将来补齐积木，仍须在报告中说明「App 图标角标 + 多端已读同步（AC4）」在单端不可验证。
selfCheck.R10: ok：本版没有任何循环动作，不会向任何人发打扰消息；也未使用 prepare-only Node。
selfCheck.R11: n/a：未提交计划，故无标题；预留标题应为「免打扰群被 @：会话列表与全局角标是否出现」（对应 q1/q2/q7）。
selfCheck.R12: ok：quotes 的 11 段均逐字取自 Issue 原文（q1/q2/q7 取自 Summary 与 Actual result，q3/q4 取自 Steps to reproduce，q5/q6 取自 Expected result，q8/q11 取自 Acceptance criteria，q9/q10 取自 Severity 与 Environment）；understanding.basis 与 missing[].basis 全部指向这些片段，没有无法追溯的断言。

risks: 本 Issue 的两条核心路径在 android-app 上都无法构造触发：一是没有 mute 开关（前置），二是没有「以另一账号发出真实 @mention」的 Node（触发）；这属于 R8 的缺积木，不是产品无问题，因此不提交近似计划，避免得到「0 复现」的假结论。
即使补上 mute 与发 @ 的积木，角标计数在 android-app 上仍缺确定性观察：会话行未读数字、底部「聊天」Tab 角标、App 图标角标都不在无障碍树里，也没有对应参考区域；需要执行端提供角标相关的 element / region（或 App 图标角标的读取通道），否则 AC1 只能靠 ai 目测，区分度不足。
「@我的 / Mentions」入口（AC5/AC6/AC7）在 android-app 上没有固定元素，且产品尚未确认移动端命名（可能是「@我」「Mentions」「提及」「Activity」之一）；在命名定型并加进 vocab 之前，任何「列表/入口不存在」的文本 absent 检查都可能在修复后仍然通过，形成误命中。
单端（android-app）无法验证 AC3 的 push 通道、AC4 的多端已读同步和 q10 要求的 Web / macOS / Windows / iOS 全端一致性；这些条目要么另开多端计划的 Issue，要么在报告中明确标为未覆盖。

建议补积木清单（供执行端评估）：① 会话/群设置里的 mute 开关元素 + 「该会话已免打扰」的 baseline 观察；② teamily.sendMention {member, text}（relogin as other 后在允许清单会话里 @ 到指定成员并发送）；③ 会话行未读角标与底部 Tab 角标的 region/element；④ 移动端「@我的」入口元素及其列表页锚点。补齐后可按本 Issue 的 q3→q4→观察角标（expect: phenomenon）→打开会话复位（afterCheck）的结构出 v2。
